title: What Mushroom Building Blocks Is
definition: Mushroom Building Blocks: building blocks grown from mycelium.
description:
Mushroom Building Blocks: building blocks grown from mycelium. This is Future Architecture & Building at its most ambitious — mycelium bricks research, block logistics engineering and growth chambers operations converging on a single goal: making block hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Architecture & Building will decide load testing outcomes this century. Mushroom Building Blocks is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working block hulls, the larger mycelium bricks vision stalls, and with it, the block logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Mushroom Building Blocks in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Mushroom Building Blocks
title: Real Research Today: Mushroom Building Blocks
definition: Today's documented research behind Mushroom Building Blocks.
description:
The road to Mushroom Building Blocks is already being paved. Robotics in construction (Built Robotics, Dusty Robotics) automates layout and earthworks. Bamboo construction research (INBAR) standardizes the world's fastest-growing structure.

Self-healing concrete and bio-cement (bioMASON) cut construction emissions. Together these programs form the mycelium bricks foundation that Mushroom Building Blocks will build on — the block logistics results, the growth chambers methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as block logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

description:

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed mycelium bricks demonstrations, block logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting growth chambers uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Mushroom Building Blocks
definition: Estimates Mushroom Building Blocks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mushroom Building Blocks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a block hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Mushroom Building Blocks Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Mushroom Building Blocks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Mushroom Building Blocks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 61964 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where mycelium bricks monitoring, block logistics redundancy, or growth chambers maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Mushroom Building Blocks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mushroom Building Blocks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mushroom Building Blocks — building blocks grown from mycelium.

Phase 1 — Prove (mycelium bricks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (block logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (growth chambers): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (load testing): block hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and construction-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
